title: pteris glauca
intro: Pteris glauca, commonly known as the Chinese fern or glaucous bristle fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris glauca include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and promote overall well-being, making Pteris glauca a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
